chapter: Russia: Tsarist Rule to the USSR
trick: Russia has two revolutions in one year and students lose marks by merging them. February 1917 removes the Tsar and gives a Provisional Government; October 1917 removes that government and gives the Bolsheviks. February ends the monarchy, October begins communism.
